description: A date axis in the built-in chart panel of the Svelte 5 data grid. Group a daily signups sheet by its date column and the panel adds a Date axis toggle that spaces points by actual time with real date ticks, alongside a Log scale toggle for the wide-range value axis; both are one click, live, and persist in saved views. Retype a value, re-pick a column or filter the grid and the line re-plots.

faq.question: When does the Date axis toggle appear?
faq.answer: When the Group by column has cellDataType date. The panel then offers proportional time spacing instead of equal steps.

faq.question: What does Log scale help with?
faq.answer: Values that span orders of magnitude, such as signups from a few dozen to thousands; a base-10 axis keeps the small days visible next to the large ones.

faq.question: Are the toggles saved?
faq.answer: Yes. They are part of the chart state that saved views capture, so a view restores the same axis settings.
